title: Looking For Play Testers
author: jfrem
selftext:
Hey, I'm looking for a few Android players to help test my new mobile game Origin Trail! Vibe coded this with Claude the last couple months, crazy time to be alive.

**Game Title: Origin Trail**

**Playable Link:** Email me at [origintrailsupport@gmail.com](mailto:origintrailsupport@gmail.com) and I'll get you on the closed test group

**Platform:** Android

**Description:** Origin Trail is a free to play mobile survival-strategy game that reimagines the classic *Oregon Trail* among the stars. Earth is dying, and you've been chosen to lead a small crew of colonists on a one-way journey across fifteen star systems to a new home world called New Eden. Every leg of the trip is a gamble: you'll ration Food, Water, Fuel, and Air as you go, and a single bad decision can leave your crew starving, suffocating, or stranded light-years from anywhere. Along the way you'll dock at trading stations, negotiate with alien civilizations, weather solar storms, and navigate black holes and wormholes. While random events constantly test your luck and your leadership. Each colonist brings their own skills and weaknesses, morale rises and falls, and no two journeys play out the same.

**Free to Play Status:**

* \[ \] Free to play
* \[x\] Demo/Key available
* \[ \] Paid (Allowed only on Tuesdays with \[TT\] in the title)

**Involvement:** I'm the sole developer
